Tianyu Cui 1 Song-Jun Xu 1 Artem Moskalev 1 Shuwei Li 1 Tommaso Mansi 1 Mangal Prakash 1 * Rui Liao 1 *
Abstract
Inferring Gene Regulatory Networks (GRNs)
from gene expression data is crucial for under-
standing biological processes. While supervised
models are reported to achieve high performance
for this task, they rely on costly ground truth
(GT) labels and risk learning gene-specific bi-
ases—such as class imbalances of GT interac-
tions—rather than true regulatory mechanisms.
